text.tspan: People living with tuberculosis by drug susceptibility World
Estimated number of people living with tuberculosis, broken down by drug susceptibility level.

tspan.tspan: Data includes only tuberculosis cases in HIV-negative people. Tuberculosis cases among people with HIV are classified under HIV/AIDS
